svg.title: Cell biology overview
svg.desc: Cell structures: Animal: nucleus → DNA/control; cytoplasm → reactions; membrane → entry/exit. Mitochondria: aerobic respiration. Ribosomes: make proteins. Plant/algal extras: cellulose wall; permanent vacuole. Photosynthetic cells have chloroplasts. Bacteria: smaller; no nucleus; DNA loop; some plasmids. Specialised cells: Sperm: tail, mitochondria, acrosome enzymes. Nerve: long fibre, branches. Muscle: contractile proteins, mitochondria. Root hair: large absorption area. Xylem: hollow, lignified; water/minerals. Phloem: sugars; companion cells. Differentiation & stem cells: Differentiation: becoming specialised; animals mainly early, plants throughout life. Embryonic: most human cell types. Bone marrow: limited types. Meristems: any plant type. Uses: tissue repair; plant clones. Weigh benefits, infection risk and ethical objections. Microscopy: Resolution: distinguish nearby points. Electron microscopes give more detail and magnification. Magnification = image ÷ actual size. Same units first: mm → µm ×1,000. Practical: thin stained sample, angled coverslip; low power first; focus, draw, label and add a scale. Culturing microorganisms: Binary fission: repeated doubling. Population = start × 2ⁿ; n = time ÷ division time. Asepsis: sterilise, cool loop; tape edges, invert; school cultures ≤25°C. Compare antimicrobial discs; solvent control; repeat. Zone area = πr²; r = diameter ÷ 2. Cell cycle: Grow → copy DNA → mitosis → divide. Copies separate; nuclei, then cytoplasm/membrane divide. Two identical cells; same chromosome number. For growth, development, repair and replacement. Diffusion & exchange: Diffusion: net particles high → low; no respiration energy. Faster: steeper gradient, hotter, larger area. Large organisms: lower SA:V → exchange/transport systems. Cube: SA = 6a²; V = a³. Alveoli, villi, gills: large area, thin barrier, blood supply; gas exchange needs ventilation. Osmosis & active transport: Osmosis: water, dilute → concentrated, through a partially permeable membrane. Water gain: plant turgid; animal swells. Loss: plant flaccid; animal shrinks. Practical: equal plant samples; weigh, soak, blot, reweigh. % change = (final − initial) ÷ initial × 100. Active transport: low → high; respiration energy. Root minerals; gut sugars.
